note: §18.4, §18.5 — item recipes. Shelter modules live in lib/shelter/recipes.dart because they are levels of a structure rather than things you carry. `work_minutes` is §18.3's base, before Engineering, tools and the workshop. `tools_any_of` is a list of item ids of which any one will do; an empty list means bare hands are enough. `workshop_level` is the minimum the shelter must have, 0 for anywhere.
_comment: §18.4's recipes. ⚠ The count matters as much as the cost: every improvised row here makes something far lighter than the smallest unit the game has — a dressing is 50 g and the smallest thing anybody can pick up is a 0.3 kg bolt of cloth. A recipe cannot cost a fraction of a unit, so these used to cost a whole one and make one thing, and ninety-five per cent of the material vanished. One sitting now makes several, which is what a person actually does with a torn-up shirt. What is left over is offcuts, and offcuts are real: the rows land between forty and a hundred per cent of the mass that went in. The work time is per sitting, not per piece — you tear the shirt once.
